criteria.description: Native and external language modes have separate capability/configuration surfaces and do not require dataset placeholder syntax.
criteria.evidence: LanguageAdapterMode descriptors, phase_09_language_bridges.yaml, and native/external adapter tests.

criteria.description: Generic, Gemma, MedGemma, and gated M3D-LaMed adapters enforce causal/connector architecture contracts.
criteria.evidence: tests/phase_09/test_language.py architecture, native capability, tied-weight, and research-gate coverage.

criteria.description: External 2D, native 3D, and WSI visual tokens produce finite causal-language loss.
criteria.evidence: Phase 09 smoke forwards XRAY_2D, CT_3D, and PATHOLOGY_WSI tokens; validator repeats all three modalities.

criteria.description: At least one native VLM path produces finite loss and bounded generation.
criteria.evidence: MedGemmaAdapter tiny native connector smoke and deterministic stop/limit tests.

criteria.description: Linear, MLP, and fixed-query Perceiver bridges validate dimensions, masks, and fixed token budgets.
criteria.evidence: tests/phase_09/test_bridges.py and bridge contracts in medfm/models/bridges/.

criteria.description: Coordinate features cover 2D, 3D, and WSI metadata and alter the intended representation.
criteria.evidence: Coordinate encoder tests cover normalized/physical positions, spacing, series, MPP, pyramid, slide, view, and timepoint metadata.

criteria.description: Only assistant output positions contribute to loss; prompt, visual, and padded positions are masked.
criteria.evidence: Prompt-mask and visual-attention assertions in test_language.py plus framework masking implementation.

criteria.description: Visual representations and bridge/boundary modules receive gradients while Stage 1 vision/LM modules remain frozen.
criteria.evidence: Phase 09 smoke and test_language.py retain visual-token gradients and check frozen model parameters.

criteria.description: Static Stage 1-4 trainable-module declarations are available without implementing trainer/optimizer internals.
CUDA reference memory is measured for 32, 64, and 128 visual-token buckets.
criteria.evidence: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU training reference: 33.204, 50.343, 68.016 MiB allocated; 40, 58, 76 MiB reserved.

criteria.description: CUDA FlashAttention remains optional and SDPA/eager/XLA-compatible attention plus generation operation records are exposed.
criteria.evidence: LanguageAdapterConfig attention validation, optional flash flag, static bucket config, and xla_generation_report().

criteria.description: Tied input/output embeddings can be re-established after placement through the adapter contract.
criteria.evidence: Tiny native and external tests call verify_tied_weights(); retie_shared_embeddings() calls the model's official tie_weights hook.

criteria.description: TPU HBM/compile, CUDA/TPU parity, and XLA adapter-reload execution are measured where feasible or explicitly blocked.
criteria.justification: torch_xla is not installed on the workstation. Static XLA-safe contracts and a zero steady-state recompilation threshold are recorded; no TPU result is fabricated.
